source_status: as-surveyed existing VIPP beam (AFGC technical sheet, 2010)
geometry_notes: An as-surveyed (reconnaissance physique) post-tensioned VIPP beam of an unnamed five-span viaduct; the left and right halves differ by 1-4 cm as measured and are modelled asymmetrically exactly as dimensioned. It is one real beam, not a French standard family.
x = 0 at the web centreline; the part chains are used where they disagree with the printed totals (support bottom 0.25+0.42+0.25 = 0.92 vs 0.91; mid-span top 0.51+0.22+0.55 = 1.28 vs 1.29).

The top flange underside is a straight line from the tip to the web top (the level where the web chain starts); the top face is a straight line between the two tip tops (not horizontal because the tip heights differ).
The drawing is not to scale (the 0.09 tip scales to ~0.14 m); printed values govern.
Mid-span web 0.22 m vs support web 0.42 m: the support section is the thickened end zone.
